queries.result: First-party discovery found Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) map-search and official online Mouza-map purchase portals. No Golapganj-specific public vector parcel endpoint was found in indexed results.

queries.result: বাংলা অনুসন্ধানে সরকারি DLRS অনলাইন ভূমি রেকর্ড/নকশা অনুসন্ধান, Mouza-map portal, এবং ভূমি নকশা প্রকল্প পাওয়া গেছে; Golapganj-এর জন্য বেনামী parcel ID-plus-geometry API পাওয়া যায়নি।

registryEvidence: The official DLRS settlement map-search service exposes Bangladesh's division/district/survey/upazila/mouza/sheet/plot workflow; this is national official cadastral-map custody and procedure evidence applicable to the Sylhet/Golapganj hierarchy, not proof of an open citywide parcel feed.
